title: Coasts, shallow water, ocean, and rivers
start_policy: Start now using published candidates, frozen inputs, or explicit local proxies; integration_inputs are convergence obligations, not start gates.
scope: Prioritize static shoreline topology, beach shape/width/slope, sand and wet-edge materials, bathymetry, visible shallows, and static water; retain river corridors, banks, junctions, mouths, relief-carving inputs, and crossing anchors.
Defer ocean waves, moving surf/foam, animated normals/caustics, and river-flow animation. Interpret screenshot references selectively without baking transient water effects into static beach art.
acceptance: Coves, points, islands, channels, long runs, sources, junctions, mouths, relief, and wrap contain no periodic S-template, water plate, painted-on surf ribbon, or disconnected river.

Static beaches remain convincing with wave/foam layers disabled or omitted, with coherent dry/wet sand, terrain blending, submerged detail, and depth transitions at both zooms and during camera-only scrolling. No hydrology animation or time-driven hydrology redraw is required or introduced.

shoreline_policy.owner: Q3 classifies hill/water edges, suppresses sand, and supplies shoreline seam data; Q4 owns rock faces and hill joins.
shoreline_policy.acceptance: Proxy-relief and composed witnesses cover hill/lowland controls, mixed rocky/sandy corners, all boundary orientations, water types, and wrap at both zooms without cracks, water lips, or mandatory beaches.
